name: convention-package-keys
description: A string under a package key of an applied convention row, a member of the row's configuration file whose strings name the packages its tool loads, uses the dependency it names by the dependency's name or by that name, a colon and a name, so the builder package and the polyfill an Angular workspace file names are used. The string uses no peer the named package requires, so a required peer nothing else uses is reported, and a string under a member no package key names is no use. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named angular for the package @angular/build, its range holding the installed version, whose package keys read from angular.json include builder and polyfills and not prefix.
